name: QA login signs the test robot into the app

planSteps.description: Navigate directly to the QA test login page at /qa/login
The page heading is 'QA test login' and the form shows an email field labelled 'Email address', a password field labelled 'Password', and a 'Sign in' button
Type the QA account email into the Email address field and the QA login password into the Password field, then click Sign in
The browser leaves /qa/login and /login and lands inside the signed-in app on a project board, not on a public marketing or sign-in page
